GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Ecosystems.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Ecosystems.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on The Ecosystems.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Ecosystems.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution and Biodiversity.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution and Biodiversity.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution and Biodiversity.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution and Biodiversity.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrolysis? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrolysis.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrolysis.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Electrolysis.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrolysis.

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics.

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Polymers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Electrolysis and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

6. B — newton (N)

7. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrolysis.

8. A — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
